description: This file defines a custom JSON serializer `MaskedValueSerializer` for masking string values during JSON serialization within the Fineract project. It extends Jackson's `JsonSerializer` and uses a utility method to mask sensitive values before writing them to JSON.

classes.name: MaskedValueSerializer
classes.description: A custom Jackson JSON serializer that masks string values for sensitive data during JSON output.

methods.name: serialize
methods.description: Overrides the serialize method to mask the string value if it's not null or blank before writing it to JSON output.
